crossRefs.note: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.
Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.
Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
Abraham called the name of that place “Yahweh Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will…
For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone; that…
“I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I…
“ ‘How do you say, “We are wise, and Yahweh’s law is with us?” But, behold, the false pen of the scribes has made that…
Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice…
But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of…
he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.
Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

translations.web: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.
translations.bsb: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
translations.kjv: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
translations.asv: It is time for Jehovah to work; For they have made void thy law.
